name: @mordonezdev/logokit
description: CLI for logokit: generate brand lockups (SVG or PNG) from any logo.
author: mordonez

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @mordonezdev/logokit-core build && pnpm run sync:assets && tsup src/index.ts --format esm --target node20 --clean --external commander --external @resvg/resvg-js --external dompurify --external image-size --external jsdom --external opentype.js --external zod
scripts.sync:assets: rm -rf assets && mkdir -p assets && cp -R ../core/assets/. assets/
